items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Well, maybe they might have had Boots and his Buddies. See, all that's the same thing.

ctx.x: And where were they from? San Antonio. I see. I think that's the band that made a record with them. They just didn't know anything about them.
Well, maybe they might have had Boots and his Buddies. See, all that's the same thing.
Oh, they're all the same guys. I've got so many questions, I know we're never going to get to them. Did you know Jack T. Gardner in Texas? Oh, yeah, sure. Jack's son is there, yeah.
